basis: Qualitative maintainer observations; not measured benchmarks or provider prices.

agents.codex: Medium relative cost; cautious and precise, strong backend and flagship overall execution. Average frontend aesthetics and limited divergent ideation.
agents.dsh: Low relative cost; effective for small familiar tasks with cache reuse. Moderate frontend, backend and ideation.
agents.cursor: Low relative cost (Grok lane); reserve for large batches of repetitive, low-requirement work.
agents.kimi: Higher relative cost; good at 3D modeling, with moderate frontend and backend skills. Needs precise requirements and verifiable acceptance criteria.
